content_zh:
此刻，无天感觉体内力量澎湃，似汪洋般奔流不息，欲破体而出。
“唰！”
霍然起身，身形前冲，拳头暴探，猛然轰在地上，地面轰然而震，山洞剧烈摇晃，碎石坠落，泥土飞扬。
无天有些呆愣，开启体魄后的力量，比之以往，根本就不是一个层次，这就好像一个是天，一个是地，中间横着一道鸿沟，只有跨过这条沟，才看得见对面的风景。
这种可怕的脱变，怪不得每个人都希望成为修者。
快速跑出山洞，无天跃入丛林，消失不见，而就在他消失不久，一名大汉出现在洞口处，看着眼前的场景，面沉如水。
“小杂种没死？不可能，千丈高的悬崖，根本没有逃生的机会，可能是什么妖兽在这里修炼，不过以防万一，还是要找到他的尸骨。”
龙河眸子寒光闪烁，几步迈出，融入密林之中。
“呱。”山洞百丈处，大树成群，枝繁叶茂，其中一颗大树中，传出一声蛙鸣。
“小家伙，别吵，小心被发现了。”无天捂住小天的大嘴，死死的盯着，那在密林中穿梭的身影。
“依现在的情况看，龙河势必不会放过我，定会在村口守着，看来只能在后山躲一阵子，等到火云宗前来招收弟子再出去，到时众目睽睽之下，任他再胆大，也不敢有所作为。”
无天咕哝几句，从树下跃下，几个跳跃间，便消失在山中。
时间匆匆而过，转眼之间，二十天已经过去。
这天早上，天边刚刚泛白，残余的夜色尚未散尽，大地还处在昏暗之中。
“吼！”
后山某处，一道咆哮声响起，震耳欲聋，乍听之下，仿佛是妖兽在迎接朝阳，吐纳朝气，但仔细聆听，会发现这道声音中，带着一丝痛苦与惊恐。
视线拉近，原来这是一头山猪，身躯庞大，能有两米长，四肢粗壮如蛮牛，浑身长满寸长的黑毛，宛如钢针般，泛着丝丝寒光。
山猪是后山常见的妖兽，其肉质甘甜，是龙村较为常吃的食物，但它有脱胎初成期的实力，只有龙河能够猎杀，其余人遇见，只有逃命的份。
而此刻，龙河并不在这里，但那庞大的身子，却遍体鳞伤，血液直流，灯笼大般的眼睛，充满了惊恐。
其前方站着一名手持匕首的血衣少年，血衣中有少许的部分却是古铜色，足见这并不是衣衫，而是被血液染红的身体，血腥味十足。

山猪后方是一只拳头大的魔蛙，仔细看，会发现那并不是魔蛙，而是异兽榜排名第十的吞元蛙。
这一人一蛙，正是无天和小天。
“小天，前后夹击。”
无天轻喝，身躯冲出，手中匕首幽光闪烁，朝着山猪头颅刺去。同时，小天蛙鸣一声，弹跳而起，大嘴张开，露出两排洁白的钢牙，闪着寒光，极为骇人。
“吼！”
山猪发狂，人立而起，捶胸跺足，朝着无天疯狂撞去，速度极快，转瞬临近，伸出粗而有力的前腿，不偏不倚，对着匕首扫去。
“发狂的山猪，难道都是这副模样？”
无天有些发愣，这些天不止猎杀一头山猪，而每次到最后，山猪都会发狂，与此刻的情况一模一样，完全失去理智，横冲直撞。
不过，经过这些天血的洗礼，无天动作一点都没迟钝，身躯后仰，躲避开去，持着匕首的手，反手刺去，正好刺入山猪腹下，噗的一声，血液飚射。
“呱。”
同时，一道黑影闪过，小天咬在山猪喉处，咔嚓一声，喉管当场咬断，血狂涌了出来。
“呜！”
山猪身躯抽搐，悲鸣一声，双眼泛白，砸在地上，无天一个驴打滚，快速避开。
狼狈的站了起来，瞧了瞧浑身的血浆与泥土，无天不由苦笑，这些天只顾着修炼，与妖兽搏杀，战斗经验倒是丰富不少，但完全没有注意到，身体已经布满了污垢，散发着阵阵恶臭，完全就像一个叫花子。
无天摇了摇头，望向朝阳初升的天边，喃喃：“今天就是火云宗前来招收弟子的日子，该回去了。”
清晨，朝阳东升，朝气蓬勃。
六名孩子，赤‘裸’着身子，迎着朝阳，站在村庄前的一块空地上，哼哈哼哈的挥舞着拳脚。
“孩子们，一天之计在于晨，清晨朝阳初升，精气充沛，最易纳气入体，化气为元，开启人体之魄，成为强大的修者！”旁边龙河细心教导，指出不足。

content_en:
At this moment, Wutian felt that the power in his body was surging, rushing like a vast ocean, and he wanted to break out of his body.
"Uh-huh!"
Huoran stood up, rushed forward, thrust out his fist, and slammed into the ground. The ground shook violently, the cave shook violently, gravel fell, and soil flew.
Wutian was a little stunned. The power after opening his body was not on the same level as before. It was like one was the sky and the other was the earth. There was a gap in the middle. Only by crossing this gap could you see the scenery on the other side.
With this terrible transformation, no wonder everyone wants to become a cultivator.
Quickly running out of the cave, Wutian jumped into the jungle and disappeared. Not long after he disappeared, a big man appeared at the entrance of the cave. Looking at the scene in front of him, his face was as sinking as water.
"The little bastard is not dead? Impossible. There is no chance of escape on a thousand-foot-high cliff. It may be some kind of monster cultivating here, but just in case, we still need to find his bones."
Long He's eyes flashed coldly, he took a few steps and blended into the dense forest.
"Croak." A hundred feet away from the cave, there were clusters of big trees with lush branches. A frog croaked from one of the big trees.
"Little guy, don't make any noise, be careful of getting discovered." Wutian covered Xiaotian's big mouth and stared at the figure walking through the dense forest.
"Based on the current situation, Long He will definitely not let me go. He will definitely guard at the entrance of the village. It seems that he can only hide in the back mountain for a while until the Fire Cloud Sect comes to recruit disciples before going out. Then in full view of the public, no matter how bold he is, he will not dare to do anything."
Wutian muttered a few words, jumped down from the tree, and disappeared into the mountains in a few jumps.
Time flies by, and in the blink of an eye, twenty days have passed.
This morning, the sky had just turned white, the remaining darkness of night had not yet dissipated, and the earth was still in darkness.
"Roar!"
Somewhere in the back mountain, a roar sounded, deafening. At first glance, it sounded like a monster welcoming the morning sun and exhaling vitality. But if you listen carefully, you will find that there is a trace of pain and panic in this voice.
Looking closer, it turns out that this is a wild boar. It has a huge body, up to two meters long, with limbs as thick as a bull. The whole body is covered with inch-long black hair, like steel needles, glowing with a cold light.
The wild boar is a common monster in the back mountains. Its meat is sweet and it is a common food in Long Village. However, it has the strength to emerge from the early stage of rebirth. Only Long He can hunt it. The rest of the people who encounter it can only run for their lives.
At this moment, Long He was not here, but his huge body was covered with bruises, blood was flowing, and his eyes as big as lanterns were full of fear.
In front of him stood a young man in blood-clothed clothes holding a dagger. A small part of the blood-clothed clothes was bronze, which showed that this was not clothes, but a body dyed red with blood, full of blood smell.
Behind the boar is a fist-sized demon frog. If you look carefully, you will find that it is not a demon frog, but the yuan-swallowing frog ranked tenth on the list of strange beasts.
This person and the frog are Wutian and Xiaotian.
"Xiaotian, attack from both front and back."
Wutian drank softly, and rushed out. The dagger in his hand flashed, and stabbed towards the boar's head. At the same time, Xiaotian frog croaked, jumped up, opened his big mouth, revealing two rows of white steel teeth, shining with a cold light, which was extremely scary.
"Roar!"
The wild boar went crazy, stood up, beat its chest and stamped its feet, and rushed towards Wutian at an extremely fast speed. It was approaching in an instant, stretched out its thick and powerful front legs, and swept away the dagger without hesitation.
"Crazy wild boars, do they all look like this?"
Wu Tian was in a daze. He had not only hunted one wild boar these days, but every time at the end, the wild boar would go crazy. Just like the situation at the moment, he would completely lose his mind and go on a rampage.
However, after these baptisms of blood, Wutian's movements were not slow at all. He leaned back and dodged away. He stabbed with his backhand with the hand holding the dagger, and it hit the boar's belly. With a pop, blood spurted out.
"Quack."
At the same time, a blackThe shadow flashed, and Xiaotian bit the wild boar's throat. With a click, the throat was bitten off on the spot, and blood gushed out.
"Woo!"
The wild boar's body twitched, it let out a mournful cry, its eyes turned white, and it hit the ground. Wutian rolled around like a donkey and quickly avoided it.
Wutian stood up in embarrassment and looked at the blood and soil all over his body. Wutian couldn't help but smile bitterly. These days, he only focused on practicing and fighting monsters. He had a lot of fighting experience, but he didn't notice at all that his body was covered with dirt and exuded a stench, just like a beggar.
Wutian shook his head, looked at the horizon where the sun was rising, and murmured: "Today is the day when the Fire Cloud Sect comes to recruit disciples. It's time to go back."
In the early morning, the sun rises in the east, full of vitality.
Six children, naked, stood in an open space in front of the village facing the morning sun, humming and waving their fists and feet.
"Children, the day's plan starts in the morning. When the sun rises in the morning and the energy is abundant, it is easiest to absorb the energy into the body, turn the energy into the essence, open up the soul of the human body, and become a powerful cultivator!" Long He taught carefully and pointed out the shortcomings.
